decisive_items: Viral resistance testing showed mutations in UL97 (C592G) and UL54 (N408K) genes
Serial CMV viral load measurements:  * 63 IU/mL (1 month after initial treatment)  * 1089 IU/mL  * 321 IU/mL  * 340 IU/mL  * 660 IU/mL  * 1660 IU/mL and 3171 IU/mL (during hospital admission)
CT scan of the chest  Image Description: Shows bronchiectasis with no consolidations or ground-glass opacities
response.rationale: The patient has rising CMV viral load and resistance mutations, indicating active CMV infection. CT excludes PCP. The history of MAC is chronic and not acute.

rejected.why: CT shows no ground-glass opacities and patient on PCP prophylaxis, making PCP unlikely.
Same as R1, no evidence of PCP.
